freeze_rule: This file is frozen by the protocol commit. Any later change must be a new, separately committed amendment that records both the old and the new hash.

isolation.blocking_prerequisite: research/e4/_cache/previous_270.json is unpublished; company-disjointness against the prior 270-CIK cohort cannot be proven until it is published.

cohort.algorithm: proportional SIC strata, largest remainder, ascending SHA-256 within stratum
cohort.eligibility: original FY2026 10-K; non-financial SIC; computable B0 component; same-filing temporal component

confirmatory_systems.primary_representation_rule: Exactly one of A2 or A3 is primary. Both may not be primary. A3 must be defined and frozen in the protocol commit to be eligible.
confirmatory_systems.hybrid_weight_source: frozen transparent rule; a learned fusion requires a development set disjoint from E5 and from every E4 company, with coefficients frozen before outcome access

primary_family.question: can a strong Agent beat the deterministic temporal baseline outright
does the Agent add incremental value on top of B6
are the deterministic temporal signal and Agent reasoning complementary

adjudication.blinding: reviewers see only endpoint-construction evidence; never any score, prediction, threshold, model identity or the other reviewer's verdict

outcome.reweighting: sensitivity analysis only; never a substitute for missing labels

agent_inference_policy.justification: E4 measured a mean absolute batch-vs-single score difference of 0.101 with a rank correlation of only ~0.313; a ranking study cannot tolerate shared semantic context across companies.
agent_inference_policy.retry_policy: one unchanged retry, then deterministic left/right bisection to a single permanent failure
agent_inference_policy.failure_recording: deterministic error code plus a hash of the masked invalid response

gates.batch_size_sensitivity: rank correlation and mean score difference within frozen tolerance at sizes 1, small, target

power.unlock_gate: projected paired positive events >= 100 after endpoint and schema attrition at the frozen minimum meaningful effect

environment_variables._note: The frozen v0.3.4 default is 268435456 (256 MB) and SEC FSDS num.txt members are 500-600 MB, so E4's outcome stage required this override. E4 recorded it nowhere. E5 records every result-affecting variable explicitly.

governance.manifest_chain: each stage manifest records the previous stage's manifest hash
